name: Houndwife
source:
Your husband finally comes home after a month-long "vacation." But what walks through the door isn't the endearing man you were hoping to see. His body is covered in fur, his mouth is dripping with hunger, too large to fit the entrance, and...wings?

Just what the hell is that? 

It's Atlas—your beloved. But can you still call him that when the creature before you is barely even human? 

Tonight will be your first evening together. You'll face the mundane everyday tasks you once loved, now as foreign as the creature watching your every move.

Are you able to continue your life as the loving wife to your husband, or will you forfeit it when the beast within consumes you both?

[From [url=https://ocreatus.itch.io/houndwife]itch.io[/url]]
